rationale: The assistant correctly identified 22E as an evaporator fan fault likely caused by ice, guided a safe full defrost, and escalated to an engineer when the code returned after about 10 days. Weaknesses: it stated the defrost system fault as 'not just ice blocking the fan' and 'has likely failed', which is somewhat overconfident. It also did not mention checking warranty or receipt, and it gave a vague account of the ticking sound. No part was pushed and no unsafe DIY was given.
